limitations: No order recovery is established from finite/noisy data or an unknown observation origin.
No identifiability of all non-order parameters or statistical/clinical predictive benefit is claimed.
Arbitrary time-varying transmission is excluded; comparative priority is literature-bounded.
scientific_scope: Exact continuous initial-time incidence in a positive-parameter constant-rate Caputo SIR epidemic with a single common order and known total population. Primary classification concerns epidemiological inference and within-epidemic incidence, MSC 92D30.
title: Two-exponent identification at the critical Caputo SIR incidence cancellation
